description: This file defines a report class 'PartyLedgerSummaryReport' for generating customer or supplier ledger summaries, including methods for data retrieval, processing, and report column configuration within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: PartyLedgerSummaryReport
classes.description: Class for generating customer or supplier ledger summary reports, including data aggregation and formatting.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report with filters, setting date ranges and default company if not provided.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the report generation process, returning columns and data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure and labels of the report columns based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Processes GL entries to compile ledger data per party, including balances and adjustments.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Fetches GL entries from the database based on filters and conditions.

methods.name: prepare_conditions
methods.description: Prepares SQL conditions for data queries based on filters.

methods.name: get_return_invoices
methods.description: Retrieves return invoices within the date range for adjusting ledger amounts.

methods.name: get_party_adjustment_amounts
methods.description: Calculates adjustment amounts for parties based on related GL entries.
